root_cause: The output buffer passed to get_freq_strides() (ld->freq_res, sized for MPS_MAX_PARAM_SETS=9 per-set entries) is too small for the number of entries the function actually writes (up to data_bands+1, where data_bands can reach 28 for the finest stride/widest band range). Additionally, using ld->freq_res as both an input (ld->freq_res[set_idx] selects band_stride) and output (overwritten in-place with band-index data) creates unintended aliasing that corrupts state used later in the same function.
findings: In ff_aac_ec_data_dec(), get_freq_strides() is called with ld->freq_res used directly as the output ('freq_strides') scratch buffer: `get_freq_strides(ld->freq_res, stride_table[ld->freq_res[set_idx]], start_band, end_band)`. ld->freq_res is declared as `int16_t freq_res[MPS_MAX_PARAM_SETS]` (MPS_MAX_PARAM_SETS == 9), i.e. it is meant to hold one frequency-resolution value per parameter set. Howev
